text.en: Client opinions on staff show sharp division. Multiple long-standing pet owners praise the veterinary surgeons for empathy, gentle bedside manner, and compassionate end-of-life support for elderly dogs. In contrast, several reviewers describe front desk reception staff as rude, dismissive, and unsupportive during phone calls and arrivals.

Many owners commend the clinical team for their gentle, affectionate approach when treating neurotic cats, assistance dogs, and poorly rodents in emergencies. Pet parents appreciate the dignity shown during difficult farewell consultations. However, critical reviews strongly condemn the practice for refusing free treatment to injured stray kittens.

While one reviewer found treatments affordable and good value, financial policies attract notable criticism. Dissatisfied clients cite high out-of-hours fees applied before official closing times, pressure to agree to expensive scans, and strict requirements for upfront payments before emergency stray care, leading some to seek care elsewhere.

q.en: Does Hopwood Veterinary Centre treat small exotic pets or rodents?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the veterinary team provided compassionate emergency treatment for small pets, including rats.
Pet owners commend the veterinarians for providing gentle, unhurried, and dignified support during euthanasia appointments.

q.en: How are consultation and emergency fees handled?

a.en: Reviewers note that full consultation and out-of-hours fees apply strictly, including for emergency examinations.
